The '''Comp600 datapad''' was a type of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that was used during the age of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] wanted to falsify a [[cryodex]] with a modified Comp600 on [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
